lead_in: Luke 11:27–28 blesses the womb that bore Christ; Newman sees in that blessing the oldest promise, to Eve, at last fulfilled.

excerpt.text: In her was now to be fulfilled that promise which the world had been looking out for during thousands of years. The Seed of the woman, announced to guilty Eve, after long delay, was at length appearing upon earth, and was to be born of her. In her the destinies of the world were to be reversed, and the serpent's head bruised.
excerpt.attribution: John Henry Newman, Parochial and Plain Sermons, vol. 2, sermon 12, “The Reverence Due to the Blessed Virgin Mary,” p. 128
